Rotating the signing key

Runbook · last exercised 14 September

Releases are signed with an Ed25519 key held in the release vault. Installs verify each download against the public half they shipped with, so a rotation has to publish the new public key before the first release it signs.

Do not revoke the old key until every supported install has received an update that trusts the new one.

Before you start

  • Two maintainers on a call, each with vault access.
  • A clean checkout of the latest release tag.
  • About forty minutes, most of it waiting on CI.

Steps

  1. Generate the new pair offline with signify -G -n -p next.pub -s next.sec.
  2. Commit next.pub to keys/ and cut a release signed with the old key.
  3. Wait until the update reaches at least 95% of installs.
  4. Swap the vault entry and press Rotate in the release console. 
$ signify -V -p keys/next.pub -m release.tar.gz
Signature Verified

Which tags trust which key

Release Signed with Trusts
4.11 2023 key 2023
4.12 2023 key 2023, 2026
4.13 2026 key 2023, 2026

Questions go to the release channel. This runbook is reviewed after every rotation.
